syncs.description: Make organization group records and their stored user memberships available as a replicated dataset.
syncs.name: sync-groups

id.description: Opaque Roam Address ID identifying the group record.

location.description: Resource location from SCIM metadata, when returned.

memberIds.description: Stored member Person IDs; omitted when membership is absent, and [] when explicitly empty.

items.description: Stored member Person ID.

displayName.description: Stored group name as ordinary Unicode text.

resourceType.description: Resource type from SCIM metadata, when returned.

Group.description: An organization group and its stored user membership references.

syncs.description: Make Roam organization user records available as a replicated dataset, including identity, profile, email records, active status, and role.
syncs.name: sync-users

id.description: Opaque Roam Person ID identifying this record.

role.description: Roam role from the provider extension, when returned.

active.description: True for active and false for archived users, when returned.

primary.description: Primary flag, when returned; absence differs from false.

items.description: A stored email record.

emails.description: Stored email records, preserving order and empty arrays.

externalId.description: Provisioning-system identifier, when returned; empty text is preserved.

User.description: A replicated Roam organization user with identity, profile, emails, active status, and role.

functions.name: add-member-to-group
functions.description: Request membership for one user without replacing the group's other members. Roam skips unknown or archived users.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID to add; must resolve to an active user in the account to be applied.

groupId.description: Opaque group Address ID receiving the membership.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_addmembertogroup.description: One user and the group to request membership in.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting member Person IDs; omitted if the provider omits membership. An accepted request does not guarantee the requested user was added.

items.description: Member Person ID returned by Roam.

displayName.description: Stored group name after the operation.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_addmembertogrou.description: The actual group returned after requesting the membership addition.

tags.instructions: Obtain groupId from `list-groups` and userId from `list-users`. Use this for one addition and `batch-add-members-to-group` for up to 100 additions. Unknown or archived users are skipped rather than causing an error; inspect returned memberIds to determine the applied membership. Other members are not replaced.

functions.name: archive-group
functions.description: Archive a group and remove its members while retaining the group's data. This is not permanent deletion.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group to archive.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_archivegroup.description: The group to archive and remove memberships from.

groupId.description: Address ID targeted by the successful archive request.

archived.description: Roam accepted group archival, which also removes memberships; it does not establish permanent data deletion.

tags.instructions: Get the Address ID from `list-groups` or `get-group`. This archives the entire group and removes its members; use `remove-member-from-group` for only one association. Group data is retained, but no group-restore operation is documented. Contact Roam support for permanent deletion or recovery guidance.

functions.name: archive-user
functions.description: Archive a user and remove their access while retaining their data. This is not permanent deletion.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID of the user to archive.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_archiveuser.description: The user to archive without permanently deleting their data.

userId.description: Person ID targeted by the successful archive request.

archived.description: Roam accepted the archive operation; data was not permanently deleted.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_archiveuser.description: Acknowledgment of a successful user archive operation.

tags.instructions: Get the Person ID from `list-users` or `get-user`. This removes the user's access but retains data. Use `restore-user` to reactivate. Permanent data deletion is not available through this tool; contact Roam support for that.

functions.name: batch-add-members-to-group
functions.description: Request up to 100 membership additions to one group using a native members-array update. Unresolved or archived users are skipped.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group receiving memberships.

items.description: Person ID to add.

userIds.description: Distinct Person IDs to add, maximum 100. Unknown and archived users are skipped rather than failing the call.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_batchaddmemberst.description: One group and 1–100 distinct Person IDs whose memberships are requested.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting membership; not per-request success results. Omitted if membership is not returned.

items.description: Person ID in the resulting membership.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_batchaddmembers.description: The resulting group returned by Roam, including actual membership when available.

tags.instructions: Use an Address ID from `list-groups` and Person IDs from `list-users`. Supply 1–100 distinct user IDs. Use `add-member-to-group` for one user. This is best-effort: inspect the actual resulting memberIds, and do not assume every requested ID was applied. Other memberships are not replaced.

functions.name: batch-remove-members-from-group
functions.description: Request removal of up to 100 user memberships from one group without replacing unrelated memberships.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group losing memberships.

items.description: Person ID whose association should be removed.

userIds.description: Distinct Person IDs whose associations should be removed, maximum 100; unknown memberships are no-ops.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_batchremovemembe.description: One group and 1–100 distinct member Person IDs to remove.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting membership, not correlated per-item deletion outcomes; omitted if not returned.

items.description: Person ID in the resulting membership.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_batchremovememb.description: The actual resulting group returned by the removal request.

tags.instructions: Use an Address ID from `list-groups` and member Person IDs from `get-group`. Supply 1–100 distinct IDs. This removes associations, not users or the group; unknown members are no-ops. Use `remove-member-from-group` for a single removal. Inspect the actual resulting memberIds.

functions.name: create-group
functions.description: Create a group with a name and optional initial user memberships. Unknown or archived users are skipped by Roam.

memberIds.description: Initial Roam Person IDs, maximum 100 per call; omitted or [] requests no initial members. Unknown and archived users are skipped.

items.description: Roam Person ID to request as an initial member.

displayName.description: Name of the new group, at most 64 characters.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_creategroup.description: Name and optional initial membership for a new Roam group.

location.description: Resource location from response metadata, when available.

memberIds.description: Actual applied Person IDs, not all requested IDs; omitted if the provider omits membership.

items.description: Roam Person ID returned in the applied membership.

resourceType.description: Resource type from response metadata, when available.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_creategroup.description: Created Roam group and the membership actually returned by Roam.

tags.instructions: Use this for a new group. Obtain optional member Person IDs from `list-users`; only active users can be added. Inspect returned memberIds to see what Roam actually applied. Use `update-group` or `add-member-to-group` for an existing group. Check `list-groups` before retrying an uncertain create.

functions.name: create-user
functions.description: Provision a Roam user with an email, name, and optional role and provisioning attributes.

role.description: Initial Roam role; omitted delegates the default to Roam.

email.description: Primary email and login name; sent identically as userName and the primary email.

active.description: Initial active status; omitted delegates the default to Roam.

givenName.description: User's given name as ordinary Unicode text.

externalId.description: Optional identifier in the provisioning system; empty text is sent literally.

familyName.description: User's family name as ordinary Unicode text.

additionalEmails.description: Other email records, all non-primary; omitted means no additional emails are requested.

type.description: Optional email category; omitted means no category is sent.

items.description: An additional non-primary email record.

primaryEmailType.description: Optional category for the primary email; omitted means no category is sent.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_createuser.description: Email, name, and optional initial provisioning attributes for a new Roam user.

id.description: Created user's opaque Roam Person ID.

items.description: An email record stored and returned by Roam.

emails.description: Actual email records returned by Roam, not merely echoed input.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_createuser.description: The actual created Roam user returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use this for a new user, not an existing user's profile change; use `update-user` for that. Supply the primary email once: the tool keeps the login and primary email consistent. Roam generates the display name. Check `list-users` before retrying an uncertain creation because replay may conflict or create another resource.

functions.name: get-group
functions.description: Retrieve a group by its Roam Address ID, including the membership actually stored.

groupId.description: Opaque Roam Address ID of the group to retrieve.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_getgroup.description: Identify the group to retrieve by its opaque Roam Address ID.

location.description: SCIM metadata resource location, when returned.

memberIds.description: Stored member Person IDs; omitted when membership is absent and [] when explicitly empty.

items.description: Stored member Roam Person ID.

resourceType.description: SCIM metadata resource type, when returned.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_getgroup.description: The stored group name, opaque identity, membership, and available SCIM metadata.

tags.instructions: Use a group ID from `list-groups` or `create-group`. Use `list-groups` if you do not know the ID. Member IDs identify users and can be read with `get-user`; this call does not expand every member profile.

functions.name: get-schema
functions.description: Retrieve the documented definition metadata for one supported SCIM schema by its URN.

schemaId.description: Opaque SCIM schema URN, for example urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_getschema.description: The SCIM schema URN to retrieve.

description.description: Provider's schema description, when returned; empty text is preserved.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_getschema.description: The documented definition metadata for the requested SCIM schema.

tags.instructions: Obtain a schema URN from `list-schemas` or `list-resource-types`. Pass it unchanged, including colons. Use `list-schemas` to enumerate supported definitions instead. This is a public discovery endpoint and does not require authentication.

functions.name: get-service-provider-config
functions.description: Retrieve Roam's advertised SCIM capabilities, including PATCH and filtering support.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_getserviceprovid.description: No input parameters are needed to retrieve the public SCIM service provider configuration.

patchSupported.description: Advertised PATCH support; omitted if the provider does not report it.

filterSupported.description: Advertised filtering support; does not imply support on every resource, and is omitted if not reported.

filterMaxResults.description: Advertised filter maxResults value, when returned; not automatically a page-size or batch limit.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_getserviceprovi.description: Advertised SCIM capabilities, with unavailable capability values omitted.

tags.instructions: Use this when configuring a SCIM client or checking advertised features. Use `list-resource-types` for resource endpoints and `list-schemas` for schemas. This public discovery endpoint needs no authentication. Advertised filtering does not imply group filters work; Roam currently ignores group filters.

functions.name: get-user
functions.description: Retrieve one Roam user by their Person ID, including profile, email records, active status, and role.

userId.description: Opaque Roam Person ID of the user to retrieve.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_getuser.description: Identify the Roam user to retrieve by Person ID.

role.description: Roam role from its extension, when returned.

active.description: True for active and false for archived, when returned.

primary.description: Primary-email flag, when returned; absent is not false.

items.description: One stored email record.

emails.description: Stored email records in provider order.

externalId.description: Provisioning-system identifier, when returned; empty text is preserved.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_getuser.description: The stored Roam user profile, email records, status, and role.

tags.instructions: Use an ID from `list-users` or `create-user`. Use `list-users` instead when you only know an email address. This is a read and does not reactivate archived users.

functions.name: list-groups
functions.description: List one page of groups in the connected organization, including actual memberships.

limit.description: Requested groups per page, default 100; the provider may return fewer.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this connection and limit; omit on the first page.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_listgroups.description: Options for one page of organization groups.

id.description: Opaque Roam Address ID identifying the group.

location.description: Resource location from SCIM metadata, when returned.

memberIds.description: Actual member Person IDs; omitted if the provider omits membership, and [] means explicitly empty.

items.description: Opaque Person ID of an actual group member.

resourceType.description: SCIM resource type from metadata, when returned.

items.description: An organization group with its returned membership and metadata.
Groups in this provider page, preserving provider order.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for another page; omitted when exhausted.

totalResults.description: Provider-reported total group count when supplied, not the current page length.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_listgroups.description: One page of groups and its continuation, when available.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover group IDs for `get-group`, `update-group`, and membership tools. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the same limit for another page. Group filtering is not supported: Roam currently ignores its filter parameter. Each call returns one page.

functions.name: list-resource-types
functions.description: List the SCIM resource types supported by Roam and their discovery metadata.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_listresourcetype.description: No input is required to discover supported SCIM resource types.

id.description: Opaque SCIM resource-type identifier, for example User or Group.

endpoint.description: Relative resource endpoint reported by discovery, when returned.

schemaId.description: Core schema URN for this resource type, when returned; suitable for get-schema.

description.description: Provider explanation of the resource type, when returned.

schemaExtensions.description: Reported extension schemas, when returned; [] means explicitly none.

required.description: Whether this extension is required for the resource type, when returned.

items.description: A reported extension schema and its optional requirement flag.
Discovery metadata for one supported SCIM resource type.
Resource types in the discovery response, in provider order.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_listresourcetyp.description: The complete SCIM resource-type discovery collection.

tags.instructions: Use this when configuring a provisioning integration to discover User and Group resource types. Use `list-schemas` and `get-schema` for schema definitions, or `get-service-provider-config` for supported features. This discovery endpoint does not require authentication and returns its collection in one response.

functions.name: list-schemas
functions.description: List the SCIM schemas supported by Roam, including core resources and Roam and enterprise-user extensions.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_listschemas.description: No configuration is required to list supported SCIM schemas.

id.description: Opaque schema URN suitable as schemaId for get-schema.

items.description: A supported SCIM schema summary.
Supported schema summaries in provider order.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_listschemas.description: SCIM schema summaries returned by Roam discovery.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover schema URNs before `get-schema`. Use `list-resource-types` for resource endpoints and `get-service-provider-config` for supported features. This public discovery call returns the collection in one response and does not require authentication.

functions.name: list-users
functions.description: List one page of users in the connected Roam organization, optionally matching an email address or SCIM filter.

email.description: Exact userName/email address to match; do not combine with filter.

limit.description: Requested maximum users in this page; defaults to 100. The provider may return fewer.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from an earlier page with the same connection, filters, and limit; omit for the first page.

filter.description: Advanced SCIM filter expression, for example userName eq "alice@example.com"; do not combine with email.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_listusers.description: Options for listing one page of Roam users or matching an email or SCIM filter.

role.description: Roam role from the Roam extension; omitted if not returned.

active.description: Whether the user is active rather than archived; omitted if not returned.

address.description: Email text from the SCIM email value.

primary.description: Provider primary-email flag, when present; absence is not false.

items.description: An email record returned for this user.

emails.description: Email records in provider order; an empty array remains empty.

userName.description: SCIM login name, representing the user's email address.

givenName.description: Stored given name, including an empty string if returned.

externalId.description: Provisioning-system identifier; omitted when not returned, with empty string preserved.

familyName.description: Stored family name, including an empty string if returned.

displayName.description: Provider-generated display name; omitted when unavailable.

items.description: A Roam user with flattened names and email records.
Users in this provider page, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; omitted when the collection is exhausted.

totalResults.description: Provider-reported total users matching this request, when supplied; not the current page length.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_listusers.description: One page of Roam users, with continuation and the provider-reported total when available.

tags.instructions: Use this to browse users or find a user's ID from an email address. Use `get-user` when you already have the ID. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the same filters and limit to continue. Each call returns one page, not the entire organization.

functions.name: remove-member-from-group
functions.description: Remove one user's membership without archiving the user or the group.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID whose association is removed; unknown membership is a no-op.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group losing the membership.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_removememberfrom.description: Identify the group and the single user membership to remove.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting member Person IDs; omitted if not returned.

items.description: Member Person ID.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_removememberfro.description: Actual resulting group returned after the membership removal.

tags.instructions: Use groupId from `list-groups` and a member Person ID from `get-group`. This removes only the association, not the user or group. Unknown members are a no-op. Use `batch-remove-members-from-group` for up to 100 removals; use `archive-group` to archive the entire group instead.

functions.name: replace-group
functions.description: Replace a group's name and desired membership in one full-replacement request, subject to Roam's best-effort member resolution and archived-membership preservation.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group to replace.

items.description: Person ID to include in the desired membership.

memberIds.description: Complete desired member Person IDs, maximum 100; [] requests no active memberships. Roam preserves archived users' existing memberships and skips unresolved additions.

displayName.description: Complete desired group name, at most 64 characters.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_replacegroup.description: Complete group name and desired membership for a full replacement.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting Person IDs after resolution and archived-member protection; omitted if not returned.

items.description: Person ID in the actual resulting membership.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_replacegroup.description: Actual group state returned by Roam after replacement.

tags.instructions: Use an Address ID from `get-group` or `list-groups` and provide the entire intended name and member list. Members not included can be removed; archived users' existing memberships are preserved by Roam. Unknown or archived new members are skipped. Use `update-group` for selected fields or membership add/remove tools for incremental changes.

functions.name: replace-user
functions.description: Replace a user's complete supported profile with explicit name, email, role, active status, and external identifier values.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID whose profile is replaced.

email.description: Desired primary email and login, submitted together.

active.description: Desired lifecycle: false archives and removes access; true reactivates.

externalId.description: Complete desired external provisioning identifier; empty text requests an empty value.

type.description: Desired category; omission sends no category for this entry.

items.description: A desired secondary email record.

additionalEmails.description: Complete desired secondary email records; [] requests none.

primaryEmailType.description: Desired primary-email category; omission sends no category rather than preserving the old one.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_replaceuser.description: Complete intended supported profile and Person ID for a full user replacement.

items.description: An email record actually returned by Roam.

emails.description: Actual stored email records returned by Roam.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_replaceuser.description: Actual supported user state returned by Roam after replacement.

tags.instructions: Use this only when you have the complete intended profile and Person ID from `get-user` or `list-users`. Use `update-user` to preserve omitted fields instead. This overwrites the stored profile, can change email and role, and can archive or reactivate the user. An empty additionalEmails list requests no secondary emails.

functions.name: restore-user
functions.description: Reactivate an archived Roam user by setting their active status to true.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID of the archived user to reactivate.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_restoreuser.description: Identify the archived Roam user to reactivate.

active.description: The update response confirms the user is active.

userId.description: Person ID confirmed by the successful update.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_restoreuser.description: Confirmed identity and active status returned by the reactivation update.

tags.instructions: Use the Person ID from `get-user` or `list-users` to reactivate an archived user. This changes access status without replacing the profile. Use `archive-user` to remove access instead. The result establishes the active-status update, not any invitation delivery.

functions.name: update-group
functions.description: Change a group's name and/or replace its member list while leaving omitted attributes untouched.

groupId.description: Opaque Address ID of the group to update.

memberIds.description: Replacement member Person IDs, maximum 100; omission preserves membership and [] requests an empty list, subject to Roam's archived-user preservation rules.

items.description: Opaque Person ID to include in the replacement membership.

displayName.description: Replacement group name; omission preserves it and empty text is sent literally.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_updategroup.description: Group Address ID and at least one replacement name or membership list.

memberIds.description: Actual resulting Person IDs, which may differ from the requested replacement; omitted if not returned.

items.description: Actual resulting member Person ID.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_updategroup.description: Resulting group returned by Roam after applying the supplied replacements.

tags.instructions: Get the Address ID from `list-groups` or `get-group`. Omit memberIds to leave memberships untouched; supplying it replaces the list and can remove members. Use `add-member-to-group` or `remove-member-from-group` for incremental membership changes, or `replace-group` for full replacement. Unknown and archived additions are skipped; inspect returned membership.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Change selected stored user attributes, including a coordinated email change, without replacing the whole profile.

role.description: New Roam role; omission preserves the role.

email.description: New primary email and login, changed together; omission leaves all emails unchanged unless additionalEmails is supplied.

userId.description: Opaque Person ID of the user to modify.

givenName.description: New given name; omission preserves it, and empty text is sent literally.

externalId.description: New external provisioning identifier; omission preserves it, and empty text requests an empty value.

familyName.description: New family name; omission preserves it, and empty text is sent literally.

additionalEmails.description: Replacement non-primary email records; [] requests no secondary emails. Omitted preserves existing secondary emails.

type.description: Optional category for this secondary email.

items.description: A replacement secondary email record.

primaryEmailType.description: New primary-email category; omission preserves the existing category, and empty text is sent literally.

FunctionInput_roam_scim_updateuser.description: Person ID and selected stored user attributes to change; omitted attributes remain unchanged.

items.description: A resulting stored email record.

emails.description: Actual resulting email records in provider order.

FunctionOutput_roam_scim_updateuser.description: Actual updated Roam user returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Get the Person ID from `list-users` or `get-user`. Supply only attributes to change; omitted attributes remain unchanged. Use `replace-user` for full replacement, `archive-user` to remove access, or `restore-user` to reactivate. A changed email is applied to both login and primary email, preserving the user's identity, chat history, and group memberships.
